terms.comment: M-O’s, keeping mixtōria for the blender.

phrases.latin: Ōva et farīnam in māchinā mixtōriā misceāmus.
phrases.english: Let’s mix the eggs and flour in the mixer.

mixtus.html: Lewis & Short leaves the i unmarked in mixtum, and de Vaan (2008: 382–383) prints mixtum, mixtūra with a short i, explaining mixtum as syncopated from *mixitum. Spanish mestizo and French métis, from Late Latin mixtīcius, also continue a short i. Bennett’s list of hidden quantities has not been checked yet.

sources: Lewis & Short: machina
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. mixer, mixer: blender.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 346.
